basic_profile.bio: A seasoned gamer and military history enthusiast from Norfolk, Virginia. I've spent years sailing the virtual seas in games like World of Warships and have a penchant for naval strategy. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy building scale models of historic ships and reading up on 20th-century naval conflicts. My online hours are typically in the evenings, post 7 PM EST, as I work full-time as a systems analyst. I'm currently in a long-term relationship with my high school sweetheart.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a systems analyst with a deep interest in military history, I've developed a strong understanding of technology and naval warfare. My expertise comes from a combination of formal education in computer science and years of self-directed study in military history, particularly focused on naval battles and ship design.
